audiences.browser-auth: Browser authentication inputs/outputs, including proof/CSRF material; never an agent observation or public log.
audiences.owner-management: Authorized workspace/member/credential/preview management metadata or mutation input; no general agent access.
audiences.credential-once: One-time synthetic credential delivery; replay metadata is separately classified and cannot deliver the secret again.
audiences.world-author: Explicit world author input; contains hidden law/seed material and requires authorized author handling.
audiences.world-grantee: Explicit granted definition; contains private truth and is not part of the agent-safe world projection.
audiences.run-viewer: Authorized browser/service run-viewer data; agent-safe structure does not imply permission to disclose a run.
audiences.purchased-observation: Purchased public scientific structure/actions/outcomes; actual ownership/access remains a producer obligation.
audiences.agent-checkpoint: Opaque agent-supplied state; arbitrary contents are not certified safe to publish.
audiences.prediction-input: Public-condition prediction request; evaluation requests must not leak into a live agent's purchased view.
audiences.prediction-output: Prediction artifact; not a purchased observation or proof of accuracy.
audiences.development-evaluator: Evaluator-only development diagnostics; never given to a live agent.
audiences.package-submission: Submitter-authored package metadata; neither execution approval nor a trusted producer projection.
audiences.worker-submission: Run-worker model/checkpoint submission; does not invoke a predictor or grant evaluator authority.
audiences.control-client-input: Approved control message input only; draft routes remain excluded.
audiences.control-client-output: Approved control message output only; full result/error union is included, no generic agent-safety claim.
audiences.error: Safe structural error envelope; error ordering/authentication remain complete-boundary obligations.

exclusions: trusted producer roots absent from the exact approved root list
automatic publication or authorization based on audience labels
CLIENT1 tooling and MOCK1 transport implementation
